name: Prepare durable colonist state before game-server restart

tests.name: Land ship and set population cargo fixture

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=1,lastplanet=977704 WHERE name='colonist_restart_owner'

tests.name: Set active ship landed with five colonists

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,onplanet=TRUE,holds=50,ore=0,organics=0,equipment=0,colonists=5,slaves=0,weapons=0,drugs=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='colonist_restart_owner')
DELETE FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='colonist_restart_owner')
INSERT INTO ship_cargo(ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) SELECT ship_id,'COL',5 FROM players WHERE name='colonist_restart_owner'

tests.name: Ordinary player drops colonists before restart
Persist balanced planet and ship quantities before restart

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.population=22 AND p.colonists_unassigned=22 AND s.colonists=3 AND c.quantity=3 AND p.population+c.quantity=25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{colonist_restart_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=s.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='COL' WHERE p.planet_id=977704
